title: Nodal algebraic curves and entropy diagnostics in degenerate two-dimensional harmonic-oscillator shells
summary: Degeneracy allows the nodal structure of a quantum state to vary without changing its energy. We study this effect for real superpositions in the fixed-energy shells of the two-dimensional isotropic harmonic oscillator. In Cartesian coordinates $(x,y)$, any such state in the $N$th shell has the parametrized form $ψ_N(x,y;\mathbf{c})=ψ_0(x,y)\,P_N(x,y;\mathbf{c})$, where $ψ_0$ is the non-vanishing ground state and the real coefficients $\mathbf{c}$ determine the polynomial factor $P_N$.
